about.title: A small studio with a personal story
about.intro: We create embroidery patterns, personalised products and websites. We help turn ideas into things that matter to you and your brand.
about.story: Lilimi takes its name from the founder's daughter. It marks the personal beginning of the brand and the hope that, over time, it will become something mother and daughter build together.
about.approach: Every project starts with a conversation about your needs and expectations. Together, we define the scope, discuss the details and find an approach that fits your idea.
